_doc: Hand-curated list of canonically confirmed Devil Fruit awakenings. Source: manga panels showing the awakened ability with Oda's narration. Each entry: fruit, user, type, debut chapter, notes. Add via PR with chapter citation.

awakenings.notes: First on-page Paramecia awakening — turns environment into strings. Doflamingo explains the concept of awakening to Law.
Perospero's island-scale candy conversion during Whole Cake matches the awakening pattern, but Oda doesn't name it as awakening on-page. Implied, not stated.
Awakened mochi armament — transforms surroundings into mochi during the Luffy mirror-world fight. Confirmed canon awakening, alongside Doflamingo as one of the textbook Paramecia examples.
Cracker's biscuit creation showed traits consistent with awakening.
Impel Down feat — splitting into infinite pieces. Some readers consider this an awakening; not confirmed by Oda.

awakenings.fruit: Uo Uo no Mi, Model: Seiryu
awakenings.notes: Kaidou's Mythical Zoan feats during Onigashima — extreme regeneration, fire/water/wind dragon attacks. Awakening implied by his power level.

awakenings.fruit: Tori Tori no Mi, Model: Phoenix
awakenings.notes: Marco's regeneration during Onigashima far exceeds prior showings; awakening-adjacent ability.

awakenings.fruit: Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika
awakenings.notes: The Nika reveal — Luffy's awakening transforms his body into rubber-cartoon physics, environment included. Possibly the most lore-shaking Wano moment.
Hawkins' straw constructs and fortune-telling extensions hint at awakening but aren't explicitly confirmed.

awakenings.fruit: Inu Inu no Mi, Model: Okuchi no Makami
awakenings.notes: Yamato's wolf-deity form during Onigashima shows awakening-tier ice manipulation.

awakenings.fruit: Hebi Hebi no Mi, Model: Yamata-no-Orochi
awakenings.notes: Orochi's regenerative resilience is awakening-tier.
Awakened against Big Mom — Punk Vise + Damned Punk.
Egghead-era hints at Admiral awakening; not explicitly confirmed.
Hinted via Blackbeard arc events; not explicitly confirmed.
Kizaru's Egghead feats hint at awakened-tier light manipulation.

awakenings.fruit: Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Daibutsu
awakenings.notes: Sengoku's golden Buddha shockwaves at Marineford; awakening status not formally confirmed.
Reverie-era feats may hint at progress but not awakening-confirmed.

awakenings.fruit: Inu Inu no Mi, Model: Kyubi no Kitsune
awakenings.notes: Future Blackbeard arc development.
Bartolomeo's barrier feats during Dressrosa show traits hinting at awakening, though not formally confirmed.

Pica's stone manipulation across the entire mountain of Dressrosa fits the textbook description of awakening (environmental conversion as Doflamingo described it), but the manga never explicitly names it as such. Strong implication, not stated canon.
Sugar's mass toy conversions cover the whole kingdom; some readers consider this consistent with awakening.
Big Mom's homie creation at Whole Cake scale (entire island, weather, sea) implies awakening-level reach.
Whitebeard's world-shaking quakes at Marineford were referred to as capable of destroying the world; awakening-tier by reputation.
Enel's 200,000,000-volt Amaru and Mantra-fused output remain among the strongest Logia feats; awakening status unconfirmed.
(Updated) Egghead-arc Blackbeard feats vs Law deepen the awakening case — Liberation Punk shockwaves and Black Hole control reach awakening-tier.
(Augmented) Awakened against Blackbeard. Uses K-Room (knowledge of room interior) and powerful R Room — temporary godlike control over a small zone.
Shiryu's mastery + Haki coverage during Egghead suggests progress beyond Absalom-tier transparency.
Ryokugyu's nutrient-draining grass mass that pacified the entire Onigashima debris field is awakening-tier scale; not formally named.
S-Snake (Seraphim clone derived from Boa Hancock's lineage factor) shows wide-area petrification on Egghead — broader scale than Boa's own use.
